verdict.rationale: The only event-triggered automation in the evidence is auto-shutdown, a single built-in rule that stops a machine after a configurable inactivity period (1 hour to 1 week). Workflows automate ML pipelines, but nothing shows them firing on events. Missing for 10: user-defined rules for arbitrary events, configurable actions beyond shutdown, event-triggered Workflows or webhooks, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
